baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction predicates being joyful while located within one's ahl.
baseline_models.mechanism: A familiar belonging-group functions as the social and spatial support of the affect. The joy is therefore relationally situated rather than a free-floating mood.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication makes the joy an inhabited past condition rather than an abstract trait.
People bound by closeness and belonging supply the social container in which the condition is sustained.
Familiar habitation and freedom from estrangement turn being among the ahl into a mechanism of ease.
Joy and ease opposed to hardship provide the affective result of that familiar enclosure.

changed_reading.before: He used to be happy with his family.
changed_reading.after: His happiness was a condition produced and supported by dwelling inside a familiar network of belonging.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The joy-root also opens onto inward secrecy, while being inside one's ahl supplies a second, intimate enclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can hold a double interior: a private affect or conviction is kept inwardly inside a protected social interior. What pleases him may be more concealed than the visible merriment suggests.

activation_trace.role: Inward concealment gives the joy a private content or orientation that need not be publicly legible.
The closest people form the protected inner circle in which concealed pleasure can be nourished.
Place and position make the social interior a located sphere, not merely a list of relatives.

changed_reading.before: His happiness was an outwardly obvious family emotion.
changed_reading.after: He inhabited an intimate enclosure where an inwardly held pleasure or conviction could remain protected.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ahl can name people joined by a bond beyond genealogy, and the joy-root can point to the choicest or innermost core.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject may be located within a selected affiliation that confirms what it prizes. His joy then belongs to an identity-bearing inner circle, not necessarily only a biological household.

activation_trace.role: Belonging by religion, craft, place, or another bond keeps affinity-group membership live alongside kinship.
Fitness or worthiness introduces selection: the group can be those treated as proper or qualified insiders.
The choicest inner core makes the pleasure part of a privileged self-defining center.
Position or rank allows being among the group to carry social placement as well as location.

changed_reading.before: A man was cheerful around his immediate family.
changed_reading.after: He occupied a gratifying place inside the people he counted as his own selected circle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated ahl-plus-joy wording is split by direction. The other figure moves toward his ahl after reckoning, whereas the focus figure is statically inside his ahl and then is said to have denied any return. Domestic joy becomes an enclosed imitation of arrival rather than the joy reached through an actual return.

activation_trace.role: Past-state predication fixes the focus subject within a condition rather than giving him a directional movement.
The belonging-group is the shared destination or enclosure whose differing syntax makes the contrast visible.
The same joy image is held constant so that route and temporal placement, not pleasure itself, distinguish the scenes.
Turning back, departing, or reaching an outcome supplies real return-motion toward the other figure's ahl.
The repeated belonging-group confirms that the two scenes deliberately share a relational endpoint.
Repeated joy makes the positive scene a close mirror rather than a merely thematic parallel.
Return and reversal name precisely the movement that the focus subject presumed would never occur.

structural_cues: 84:9 uses movement toward the ahl after reckoning; 84:13 uses static location within the ahl before the denial of return in 84:14.
The ahl-plus-joy pair recurs on opposing book-receiving tracks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical repetition, motion versus static location, and a following denial of return. I infer that the static household scene functions as a substitute arrival that excludes ultimate return; a live alternative is simple narrative antithesis without that counterfeit-arrival arrow.

changed_reading.before: He once enjoyed ordinary happiness at home.
changed_reading.after: He treated being happily enclosed among his own as if he had already arrived, while denying the larger return that would undo that enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: On one track, a binding record leads through accounting and ease to joyful return. On the focus track, joy precedes a settled expectation of no return. The contrast does not condemn joy as such; it distinguishes joy that passes through accountability from joy lived as evidence of exemption.

activation_trace.role: Joy and ease are the common affective currency whose relation to accounting changes between the two tracks.
Familiar habitation supplies the local ease that can be mistaken for final security.
A written fixing that entails judgment makes accountability objective rather than optional.
Counting and accounting insert an evaluative passage between life and the other scene's joy.
Ease after difficulty shows that reckoning can issue in relief rather than merely oppose happiness.
Return or outcome places the mirrored joy after the accounting sequence.
Conviction formed from an apparent sign lets present domestic ease harden into a false conclusion about the future.
The denied return identifies the exemption that his prior joy was made to underwrite.

structural_cues: The right-hand sequence orders record, easy accounting, return, ahl, and joy; the left-hand sequence orders punishment, prior ahl-joy, and the claim of no return.
Joy occurs on both sides, but only one occurrence follows accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two ordered tracks and the focus subject's expectation. I infer that accountability, not the bare fact of pleasure, differentiates the joys; an alternative is that unlisted conduct, rather than his use of joy as evidence, carries the entire contrast.

changed_reading.before: His worldly happiness itself explains his negative fate.
changed_reading.after: The problem is happiness converted into a presumption of exemption: unlike the mirrored joy, it has not passed through truthful accounting and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The left-hand sequence repeatedly stages outer cover against inner contents: a record is put behind the back, truth is covered, yet the subject is inwardly seen and what is contained is known. This sharpens the focus joy into a stored inner orientation sheltered by familiar company but never opaque to knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Keeping something inwardly hidden makes the affect a possible carrier of private commitments, not only a visible smile.
The intimate belonging-group supplies a social interior around the subject's inwardly held world.
Putting something behind visible backs supplies deliberate spatial concealment.
The back opposed to the belly establishes an outer-versus-inner bodily axis for the hidden record.
Insight of the heart makes inward orientation available to a sight deeper than bodily surface.
Covering truth turns concealment from neutral privacy into an epistemic action.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower prevents the inner enclosure from becoming unknowable.
Gathering meaning in the heart names the inward accumulation that the focus joy may express.
A vessel holding contents gives the private self and its household enclosure a compact container model.

structural_cues: The left-hand passage moves from a book behind the back to divine sight and then to knowledge of what the plural subjects contain.
Outer bodily placement and inner containment recur around the focus claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, back-versus-interior imagery, inward sight, covering, knowledge, and containment. I infer that the focus joy expresses a stored inner orientation; a live alternative is that the joy remains openly social while only the record and beliefs are hidden.

changed_reading.before: He displayed uncomplicated merriment among familiar people.
changed_reading.after: His merriment was the social expression of an inner world accumulated and protected among his own, covered from others but fully knowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The familiar household reads as a small container inside a world of containers that split, cast out contents, empty, gather, and pass through successive configurations. Its settled support is real at its scale but structurally temporary.

activation_trace.role: Place and position locate the subject inside a bounded domestic arrangement.
Familiar habitation makes the ahl both people and an inhabited social space.
Settled support and repose explain why that domestic arrangement feels durable.
Splitting and opening establish that even the largest overhead enclosure can fail.
Casting contents outward supplies the release mechanism that undoes enclosure.
Stripping and emptying name the resulting vacancy after contents are expelled.
Gathering dispersed things shows that containers and collectives can also be reassembled.
State after state denies permanence to any single arrangement, including domestic repose.

structural_cues: The surah begins with cosmic opening and terrestrial emptying, later moves through gathering, and then explicitly names state after state.
The focus phrase places joy inside a social habitation at the center of that sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rupture, ejection, vacancy, gathering, and serial states. I infer that the ahl functions as a micro-container subject to the same instability; an alternative is that the cosmic sequence supplies only a general judgment setting and does not redescribe domestic space.

changed_reading.before: His home and people formed a stable background for happiness.
changed_reading.after: He rested happily in a locally stable social container whose apparent permanence the surrounding sequence of rupture and regathering removes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A collateral joy-root image names the moon's concealment at a month's end. The later sequence of twilight, gathering night, completed moon, and state after state activates a phase model: the focus joy is a temporal phase that can be hidden, gathered, exposed, and superseded rather than a final identity.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication gives the happiness a bounded occurrence in time.
The moon hidden at the end of a month supplies the surprising phase-and-concealment bridge.
Twilight redness marks a visible threshold rather than a stable time.
Night and its darkness carry the sequence into concealment.
Gathering what was dispersed gives night an active collecting function.
Completion and evenness mark the moon's arrival at another phase.
The moon and its light make the focus root's hidden-moon branch contextually visible.
One condition after another generalizes the lunar phase change into human transition.

structural_cues: 84:16-19 forms an ordered threshold-night-gathering-fullness-transition sequence immediately after the focus explanation.
The focus uses a past-state verb rather than presenting joy as an enduring essence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hidden-moon branch under the focus root and an explicit lunar transition sequence. I infer a phase analogy between that branch and the focus state; a live alternative is that the oath sequence illustrates change generally without specifically reactivating the joy-root's lunar branch.

changed_reading.before: His joy was a settled personal identity.
changed_reading.after: His joy was one concealed and passing phase in a sequence moving toward exposure, completion, and another state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The joy branch includes ease opposed to hardship. Universal toil, an easy accounting, and blazing fire distribute ease and hardship across different scales. The focus happiness can therefore be genuine local relief in familiar company while still being falsely treated as final ease.

activation_trace.role: Joy as ease opposed to hardship permits the affect to be modeled as relief, not only exuberance.
Familiar habitation supplies the immediate place where estrangement and strain recede.
Laborious striving establishes toil as the encompassing human condition around the local respite.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply a contrasting form of relief that follows reckoning.
Ignited fire shows that local ease can coexist with movement toward a radically different condition.

structural_cues: The universal toil statement precedes both outcome tracks.
Ease is explicitly attached to accounting on one track, while the focus joy appears before the other track's denied return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies toil, post-account ease, joy/ease, and fire. I infer a scale distinction between temporary household relief and final ease; an alternative is that the focus joy is ethically charged for independent reasons and need not be understood as relief from toil.

changed_reading.before: His happiness was either wholly innocent comfort or inherently culpable pleasure.
changed_reading.after: It was real local relief from toil, but relief misrecognized as the final shape of his condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later collective responses sharpen ahl as an affinity community. Familiarity removes estrangement, assent settles the heart, recitation gathers, and covering blocks truth. His joy can thus be socially reinforced inside a group whose shared response makes its inward orientation feel normal.

activation_trace.role: Ahl joined by religion, place, craft, or another bond keeps an affinity community live alongside literal kin.
The prized inner core models the group as a selected center that confirms its own values.
Familiar company that removes estrangement explains the affective reward of remaining within one's people.
Assent in which the heart finds rest supplies the alternative inward response around which a community can cohere.
Gathering and joining make recitation a collective assembling pressure, not merely an acoustic event.
Covering truth supplies the shared refusal that can be normalized within an affinity group.

structural_cues: 84:20-25 addresses plural response groups, contrasting refusal with faith and fitting action.
The focus possessive ahl need not grammatically decide whether the bond is genealogical, residential, or affiliative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broad ahl membership, familiarity, heart-settling assent, gathering, covering, and plural response groups. I infer social reinforcement inside an affinity circle; the literal household remains fully live and may be the only intended referent.

changed_reading.before: His family merely happened to be present while he was happy.
changed_reading.after: His own circle may have produced and ratified the inward orientation expressed by his joy, making belonging itself part of the mechanism.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface predicate ordinarily denotes joy, not sexuality. It remains anchored because both the ahl and joy roots independently carry household-making and hidden marital branches; downstream prose should present it only as a possible intimate underside of domestic joy, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the joy-root directly inside the ahl construction, allowing marriage-made household and concealed marital intimacy to overlap.

activation_trace.role: Making an ahl through marriage narrows the social enclosure to a possible conjugal household.
A concealed marital or sexual relation gives that household joy a specifically private bodily register.
Inward secrecy contains the marital activation within privacy rather than making it a public theme.

changed_reading.before: He was generally cheerful around relatives.
changed_reading.after: His domestic pleasure may include the protected conjugal intimacy by which an ahl is made and private delight is concealed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant because forehead lines and skin-opening news are not the direct senses of the focus predicate. It remains anchored through the joy-root's facial branch and the later ironic announcement of pain; downstream prose should call it a bodily-surface echo, not claim that the verse literally says his face was inscribed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus predicate names joy through a root that also reaches facial lines, allowing inward pleasure to become readable on bodily surface.

activation_trace.role: Lines of palm and forehead give joy a possible visible inscription on the face.
Marring the face makes human striving capable of altering the very surface that displays ease.
News that opens the skin with joy is inverted when the announced content is punishment.
The description as pain-bearing supplies the affective reversal of the earlier joyful surface.

changed_reading.before: His joy was simply an internal emotion.
changed_reading.after: His inward ease may have written itself on the social face, a surface later addressed by an announcement whose painful content reverses the usual opening of the skin in joy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the navel branch is collateral to the ordinary joy sense. It remains anchored by the direct conjunction of ahl and the joy-root, then gains a separation-return mechanism from ejection and return cues; downstream prose should qualify it as a kinship-and-origin analogy rather than lexical semantics.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ahl names intimate belonging while the joy-root includes the navel and cut cord, allowing family pleasure to be modeled as attachment to origin.

activation_trace.role: Kin and closest people supply the relation of origin and attachment.
The navel and severed cord materialize belonging as a bond that both connects and has already been cut.
Casting contents outward supplies a birth-like separation from an enclosing origin.
Return and reversal place attachment to origin against the return the subject denied.

changed_reading.before: He enjoyed the company of people close to him.
changed_reading.after: His joy may register an umbilical attachment to his own origin-group, clinging to a local bond while denying the larger separation and return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material chain is highly surprising and must not be treated as a lexical gloss of joy. It remains packet-anchored because the focus root has both hidden-interior and hollow-firestick branches, while the adjacent left-hand sequence supplies latent fire emerging from a firestick and then blazing fire; downstream prose should mark it explicitly as a material analogy for concealed consequence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joy-root can image both a hidden interior and the hollow core of a firestick, making inward pleasure a possible chamber of latent ignition.

activation_trace.role: Inward concealment supplies the hidden chamber in which an unseen consequence can remain latent.
The hollow core of a firestick or reed gives that chamber a precise combustible material form.
Latent fire emerging from a firestick provides the inferred transition from concealed core to ignition.
Blazing and kindling complete the material sequence as an exposed outcome.

changed_reading.before: His inward joy and the later fire are unrelated narrative facts.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, his protected inward pleasure can resemble a hollow firestick whose latent ember becomes the blaze already named on his track.

strongest_changes: The exact ahl-plus-joy mirror turns static enclosure in 84:13 into the negative counterpart of joyful return in 84:9.
The two tracks distinguish accountable joy from joy used to infer exemption, rather than opposing joy and sorrow simpliciter.
Back, covering, inward sight, knowledge, and containment sharpen the focus joy into a stored inner orientation.
Cosmic rupture, emptying, gathering, lunar phases, and successive states make domestic ease locally real but structurally temporary.
summary.what_was_special: The focus line is unusually activated by its near-verbatim joyful-family mirror and by collateral branches of the joy-root: secrecy, settled support, hidden moon, facial marks, navel, and hollow firestick. These support several coexisting readings of the same happiness as relational ease, enclosed presumption, stored inwardness, passing phase, bodily expression, and latent consequence.
remaining_uncertainties: The concealment, lunar, bodily, umbilical, and firestick activations are branch pathways and should not replace the ordinary joy sense.
Ahl can remain a literal household even where an affinity-group mechanism is live.
The claim that present joy is used as evidence of no return is an abductive link supplied by sequence, not an explicit causal statement in the focus ayah.
The domestic-container analogy may describe the focus scene without making the household itself blameworthy.
